briefing: NASDAQ rose 1.3% and the S&P 500 rose 0.6% today, a moderate risk-on session but short of the strong (+2% NASDAQ) threshold that has historically justified deploying fresh capital. With only $89.29 in cash — far below the $500 minimum needed for a meaningful new position — we held all 7 existing positions and made no new trades, letting automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules manage the current holdings.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today the market was only moderately positive and available cash was too small to fund a meaningful new position, so the disciplined move was to hold rather than force a trade just to put cash to work.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥」（Dry Powder）指預留在場邊、等待良機出現時才動用的現金。今日大市升幅溫和，而可動用現金亦不足以建立有意義的新倉位，因此審慎的做法是持倉不動，而非勉強交易只為運用現金。

market_education.summary_en: Markets traded higher today with tech leading gains, as the NASDAQ's 1.3% advance outpaced the S&P 500's 0.6% rise, reflecting continued investor appetite for growth and momentum names. No specific news catalysts were provided in today's data feed, so this move appears to reflect broad market sentiment rather than a single headline event. Existing positions like ROAD continued to show strength, trading roughly 5% above the portfolio's average cost basis.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好，科技股帶動升勢，納斯達克指數升1.3%，跑贏標普500指數的0.6%升幅，反映投資者對增長及動能股份的興趣持續。由於今日數據未提供具體新聞觸發因素，是次升勢似乎反映整體市場氣氛而非單一消息帶動。現有持倉如ROAD表現持續強勁，股價較投資組合平均成本高約5%。
